settings.aboutStoryHeadline: From the Hills of Rusizi to the Creative Horizon
aboutStoryParagraphs: Rusizi District in the Western Province of Rwanda is home to vibrant, spirited young minds full of natural musicality, physical agility, and expressive emotion. Yet, far from the capital city of Kigali, many talented children lacked structured rehearsal spaces, costumes, artistic mentors, and protective guidance.

Rusizi Kids Foundation was established to change that reality. By creating a warm, safe community sanctuary, we invited children aged 5 to 17 to discover their artistic voice. Whether mastering modern Afrobeat synchronization, preserving ancient Rwandan Itorero dance with traditional broom regalia, or acting in short films, each child is provided a structured path to thrive.

We do not view artistic training in isolation. Every participant must be enrolled in school, with our coordinators monitoring attendance and academic effort. Through regular community cleaning actions (Umuganda) and anti-drug peer campaigns, our children grow into responsible citizens who lead by example.

aboutCoreValues.title: Talent Empowerment
aboutCoreValues.desc: Believing in the boundless artistic and intellectual potential of every child from Rusizi, regardless of socioeconomic background.

aboutCoreValues.title: Child Safeguarding & Dignity
aboutCoreValues.desc: Ensuring zero tolerance for abuse, verified parental consent for all public appearances, and safe emotional and physical spaces.

aboutCoreValues.title: Rwandan Cultural Heritage
aboutCoreValues.desc: Preserving Itorero traditional dances, storytelling, drumming, and patriotic values as an anchor of identity.

aboutCoreValues.title: Academic & Talent Synergy
aboutCoreValues.desc: Requiring all enrolled children to attend school, with after-school tutoring and book supplies provided by our partners.

aboutCoreValues.title: Civic Responsibility (Umuganda)
aboutCoreValues.desc: Instilling community solidarity, hygiene, environmental tree planting, and positive peer leadership across Rusizi.

settings.aboutProtectionPledge: Rusizi Kids Foundation strictly adheres to Rwandan child protection laws (Law N° 71/2018 relating to the protection of the child). We obtain written guardian consent before any photo publication or public artistic performance.
settings.footerMissionBlurb: Rusizi Kids Foundation (RKF) is a dedicated talent incubation nonprofit in Rusizi, Rwanda. We develop, nurture, support, and promote children and youth through dance, film, music, fashion, and education.

programs.title: Traditional Rwandan Dance (Itorero)
programs.description: Honoring Rwanda’s rich cultural heritage through traditional dance, drumming, and song. Children learn cultural values, grace, discipline, and the patriotic pride of Rwandan traditions.
activities: Traditional Umushagiriro and Intore dance coaching
Ingoma (traditional drumming) and rhythm training
Cultural storytelling and heritage appreciation
Community Umuganura and civic celebrations
achievements: Preserved traditional Rwandan folk dance across 30+ young boys and girls
Handcrafted authentic kitenge and fiber dance regalia

Script reading, dialogue rehearsal & memory exercises

programs.title: Fashion & Modeling
programs.description: Fostering self-esteem, posture, and poise through runway walking, garment presentation, and sustainable styling. Youth learn creative design appreciation and confident personal presence.

Creative styling with African kitenge prints and modern wear

Confidence-building seminars and etiquette

activities: Vocal warmups, breathing technique & ear training

Acoustic rehearsals and live stage performance

programs.title: Talent Incubation & Mentorship

Anti-drug abuse and healthy lifestyle peer campaigns
Visiting elderly community members and vulnerable families
Charity street performances for community unity
achievements: Completed 14 community sanitation and tree planting actions in Rusizi
Awarded District certificate of appreciation for youth civic leadership

announcements.title: Support Our Children & Youth Talents — Urgent Call for Sponsorship & Equipment (2026)
announcements.description:
Rusizi Kids Foundation (RKF) currently empowers over 120 talented children and youth (ages 5–17) in Rusizi, Rwanda through dance, film, acting, fashion, music, and education.

As our community grows every week, we warmly invite donors, sponsors, well-wishers, and partner organizations to support our children with:
1. School fees, scholastic materials, and uniforms for vulnerable children.
2. Training equipment, costumes, sound systems, and camera gear for daily practice.
3. Nutritional support and welfare during weekend training sessions.

Every contribution directly transforms a child's future. To support us today, click "Support Us / Donate" on our website, send Mobile Money to +250 798 465 782 (USSD: *182*1*1*0798465782#), or reach our leadership team directly on WhatsApp (+250 798 465 782). Together, let us take young talents from Rusizi to the world!
